note: Reach's 14 multiplayer commendations (the owner's list, Nov 16: halo.fandom.com 'Commendation (Halo: Reach)'). The bots play multiplayer only, so Campaign and Firefight ones are not here. need: the count each tier wants (Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Onyx, Max); cr: the credits each tier awards when reached (Max none). count says what is counted for a bot, over its counted Reach matches (tools/service_record.py commendations): medals by MCC's medal id (art/medals.json keys) or by the Medals page's group, a number from MCC's post-game report (assists, grenade kills), or kills with Reach damage types from the kill record (only matches recorded with it, from 15 November 2026).

commendations.name: Close Quarters
commendations.what: Kill an enemy up close: Gravity Hammer, Energy Sword, Shotgun or melee.

commendations.name: Crack Shot
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with a precision weapon: DMR, Needle Rifle, Focus Rifle or Sniper Rifle.

commendations.name: Downshift
commendations.what: Drive a vehicle while your passenger kills an enemy (Wheelman).

commendations.name: Grenadier
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with a frag or plasma grenade.

commendations.name: Heavy Weapon
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with a heavy weapon: Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, Plasma Launcher, Spartan Laser, Concussion Rifle or Fuel Rod Gun.

commendations.name: Jack of All Trades
commendations.what: Pull off a feat: Hijack, Skyjack, Revenge, Avenger, Yoink, EMP, Rejection, First Strike, Close Call, Extermination, Kill Joy, Kill From The Grave, Firebird, Show Stopper or Bulltrue.

commendations.name: Mobile Asset
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with a vehicle.

commendations.name: One Shot
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with a headshot.

commendations.name: Rear Admiral
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with an assassination.

commendations.name: Sidearm
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with a pistol: Magnum or Plasma Pistol.

commendations.name: Trigger Man
commendations.what: Kill an enemy with an automatic weapon: Needler, Assault Rifle, Plasma Rifle, Plasma Repeater or Spiker.

commendations.name: First Blood
commendations.what: Get the first kill of a game.

commendations.name: Closer
commendations.what: Get the last kill of a game your team wins: the game-winning kill.

commendations.name: Grudge Match
commendations.what: Kill the same enemy 5 times in one game (each enemy counts once a game).

commendations.name: Medal Collector
commendations.what: Earn a kind of medal you have not earned before.

badges_note: Badges: one-time unlocks, no tiers and no credits (the owner, Nov 16: Map Master 'a badge they unlock once they get a win on each map'; Hometown Hero his special badge). Hometown Hero is worked out on the page from the state leaderboards: #1 in the bot's home state on any board that has at least two bots of the state on it.

badges.name: Map Master
badges.what: Win a game on every one of Reach's 20 multiplayer maps.

badges.name: Hometown Hero
badges.what: Be #1 in your home state on any leaderboard (with at least one other bot from your state on it).
